summary: Execution lanes generate as hidden subagents for authorized native Task dispatch, never primary session or CLI-run targets. Native child-session readback must assert the exact dispatched executor before any worker evidence is recorded. A mismatch refuses with agent_identity_mismatch. Nesting denials, capabilities, registry digests, packet and report schemas remain unchanged; model selection remains host-owned under CD-0058.
title: Native lane dispatch asserts its executor
